# THE ORIGINAL POLYPROPYLENE PIPING SYSTEMS

Faster to install. Corrosion-free. Lasts for decades. These are just a few of the many benefits of
aquatherm's PP-RCT and PP-R pipe. Polypropylene is the perfect piping material for pressurized
mechanical and plumbing systems of all sizes. Don’t accept imitations. Choose aquatherm – the
pioneer of North American polypropylene piping.

[learn more][77]

## Aquatherm Leading the Way

Want to see the benefits aquatherm North America and heat-fused polypropylene piping offer in less
than three minutes? Look no further!

## Featured Solutions

[

### aquatherm blue

][78]

A superior alternative to steel, stainless steel and inferior plastics, aquatherm blue is a
long-lasting option for heating and cooling, compressed air and industrial piping systems.

[learn more][79]
[

### aquatherm services

][80]

Boost profits and simplify projects with aquatherm pipe fabrication services. Every prefabrication
is a catalog part item that’s built to spec for easy on-site installation.

[learn more][81]
[

### PP-R and PP-RCT PIPE, FITTINGS & PARTS

][82]
[learn more][83]
[view product catalog][84]

## Installation & Design Tools

Use the following tools to help estimate, plan, design and install with aquatherm PP-R piping
systems on your next project. Drawings, CAD/Revit files can be found at:
[https://aquatherm.com/download-cad-files][85].

QCE

Quickly estimate the cost of aquatherm PP-R piping materials, labor and tools for your next piping
system.

[VIEW TOOL][86]

Pressure test

Download instructions to perform a pressure test for aquatherm piping systems.

[VIEW TOOL][87]

Expansion Calculator

Determine the linear thermal expansion when designing PP-R piping systems to account for changes in
pipe length.

[VIEW TOOL][88]

Specifications

Look at specs to see how aquatherm PP-R piping systems can be easily integrated into existing
designs.

[VIEW SPECS][89]

Installer Manual

View or download approved heat fusion procedures that are covered during our installer training
courses.

[VIEW MANUAL][90]

## Applications

### Heating & Cooling Systems

Since it’s a natural insulator and corrosion-free, aquatherm PP-R and PP-RCT piping is ideal for
heating and cooling systems in everything from commercial buildings to single-family residences.

[LEARN MORE][91]

### Industrial Piping Systems

Offering excellent chemical resistance and other advantages over other materials, aquatherm pipe
systems are ideally suited for a wide range of industrial applications.

[LEARN MORE][92]

### Fire Protection Applications

Fire protection systems are critical for protecting costly investments and preventing loss of life,
and our systems can provide valuable peace of mind.

# THE ORIGINAL POLYPROPYLENE PIPING SYSTEMS

Faster to install. Corrosion-free. Lasts for decades. These are just a few of the many benefits of
aquatherm's PP-RCT and PP-R pipe. Polypropylene is the perfect piping material for pressurized
mechanical and plumbing systems of all sizes. Don’t accept imitations. Choose aquatherm – the
pioneer of North American polypropylene piping.

[learn more][77]

## Aquatherm Leading the Way

Want to see the benefits aquatherm North America and heat-fused polypropylene piping offer in less
than three minutes? Look no further!

## Featured Solutions

[

### aquatherm blue

][78]

A superior alternative to steel, stainless steel and inferior plastics, aquatherm blue is a
long-lasting option for heating and cooling, compressed air and industrial piping systems.

[learn more][79]
[

### aquatherm services

][80]

Boost profits and simplify projects with aquatherm pipe fabrication services. Every prefabrication
is a catalog part item that’s built to spec for easy on-site installation.

[learn more][81]
[

### PP-R and PP-RCT PIPE, FITTINGS & PARTS

][82]
[learn more][83]
[view product catalog][84]

## Installation & Design Tools

Use the following tools to help estimate, plan, design and install with aquatherm PP-R piping
systems on your next project. Drawings, CAD/Revit files can be found at:
[https://aquatherm.com/download-cad-files][85].

QCE

Quickly estimate the cost of aquatherm PP-R piping materials, labor and tools for your next piping
system.

[VIEW TOOL][86]

Pressure test

Download instructions to perform a pressure test for aquatherm piping systems.

[VIEW TOOL][87]

Expansion Calculator

Determine the linear thermal expansion when designing PP-R piping systems to account for changes in
pipe length.

[VIEW TOOL][88]

Specifications

Look at specs to see how aquatherm PP-R piping systems can be easily integrated into existing
designs.

[VIEW SPECS][89]

Installer Manual

View or download approved heat fusion procedures that are covered during our installer training
courses.

[VIEW MANUAL][90]

## Applications

### Heating & Cooling Systems

Since it’s a natural insulator and corrosion-free, aquatherm PP-R and PP-RCT piping is ideal for
heating and cooling systems in everything from commercial buildings to single-family residences.

[LEARN MORE][91]

### Industrial Piping Systems

Offering excellent chemical resistance and other advantages over other materials, aquatherm pipe
systems are ideally suited for a wide range of industrial applications.

[LEARN MORE][92]

### Fire Protection Applications

Fire protection systems are critical for protecting costly investments and preventing loss of life,
and our systems can provide valuable peace of mind.

[LEARN MORE][93]

# Day or night, prompt service and exceptional value are just one phone call away.

Iceberg Home Services is a family-owned company providing [air conditioning][185], [plumbing][186],
and [indoor air quality][187] services in Lakeland, Winter Haven, Orlando, and throughout Central
Florida. Our promise is to deliver prompt service by trained and certified technicians, convenient
24/7 availability, and a helpful, friendly approach to customer care.

## HVAC Services

Our team has experience servicing all HVAC system makes and models, including central air
conditioning, [heat pumps][188], [ductless mini-splits][189], and more. We are available [24/7 to
deliver emergency HVAC repair services][190] throughout Central Florida to help you regain total
comfort quickly and efficiently.

## Plumbing Services

Never let another plumbing problem take you by surprise. Our plumbing technicians have the skills
and experience necessary to resolve all your service requests. From[ sump pump installation][191]
and [water filtration][192] to [24/7 emergency plumbing repair][193], we are here to keep your
systems running smoothly and safely!

## Skills & Certifications

At Iceberg Home Services, we take certification and experience seriously. We take pride in
continuously training our team in the most advanced HVAC and plumbing solutions so we can deliver
the industry-leading service you’ve come to expect from our team. We’re proud to be NATE-certified
for your peace of mind.

## Customer-Focused Approach

Nothing is more important to us than our customers. We go above and beyond to treat your home and
personal property as we would members of our own family. Our goal isn’t just to provide the most
exceptional home service but to be a helpful, reliable resource to you and your family in your time
of need.

**Experience the difference in working with a team that cares. Contact Iceberg Home Services at
[(863) 345-0493][194] to request HVAC or plumbing service in Central Florida today!**

# Day or night, prompt service and exceptional value are just one phone call away.

Iceberg Home Services is a family-owned company providing [air conditioning][185], [plumbing][186],
and [indoor air quality][187] services in Lakeland, Winter Haven, Orlando, and throughout Central
Florida. Our promise is to deliver prompt service by trained and certified technicians, convenient
24/7 availability, and a helpful, friendly approach to customer care.

## HVAC Services

Our team has experience servicing all HVAC system makes and models, including central air
conditioning, [heat pumps][188], [ductless mini-splits][189], and more. We are available [24/7 to
deliver emergency HVAC repair services][190] throughout Central Florida to help you regain total
comfort quickly and efficiently.

## Plumbing Services

Never let another plumbing problem take you by surprise. Our plumbing technicians have the skills
and experience necessary to resolve all your service requests. From[ sump pump installation][191]
and [water filtration][192] to [24/7 emergency plumbing repair][193], we are here to keep your
systems running smoothly and safely!

## Skills & Certifications

At Iceberg Home Services, we take certification and experience seriously. We take pride in
continuously training our team in the most advanced HVAC and plumbing solutions so we can deliver
the industry-leading service you’ve come to expect from our team. We’re proud to be NATE-certified
for your peace of mind.

## Customer-Focused Approach

Nothing is more important to us than our customers. We go above and beyond to treat your home and
personal property as we would members of our own family. Our goal isn’t just to provide the most
exceptional home service but to be a helpful, reliable resource to you and your family in your time
of need.

**Experience the difference in working with a team that cares. Contact Iceberg Home Services at
[(863) 345-0493][194] to request HVAC or plumbing service in Central Florida today!**

# Shield What Matters

Delivering quality, safety, and confidence where it counts.

## Unique Applications Require Unique Solutions

Every unique operation requires a unique solution. Sentry Equipment engineers and manufacturers
ensure your equipment meets application requirements through innovative products and services.

[Explore our Expertise][38]
[
][39]

## Always Moving

Our world moves because a million other things move. We make sure things keep moving by using the
best tools and continuing to learn as a team. From making custom pieces, solutions, and defining
quality, Sentry Equipment is right there with you.

[ Explore Sentry's Expertise ][40]

### Always Moving

## Solutions to Fit Your Needs

Protecting your investments is our focus. Sentry solutions ensure you’re covered whether you need
seal kits or a complete installation of a SWAS.

### Sampling Equipment

Ensure product accuracy with a representative sample from your processes.

[ See More ][41]

### Clarifier Equipment

Welded clarifier bodies and custom programmed drives ensure that your operations maintain high
efficiency.

[ See More ][42]

### SmartSkim Equipment

Operate more efficiently, economically, and safely with coolant recycling and oil separating
solutions.

[ See More ][43]

### Maintenance Services

Extend your equipment's lifecycle with maintenance and troubleshooting expertise.

[ See More ][44]

### Top Work Places

Sentry Equipment has been recognized as USA TODAY Top Places to Work for 2026. This award celebrates
outstanding companies that listen to their people and put them at the center of decisions to build
cultures where people and performance thrive.

[ Join Our Team ][45]

### Ownership in Action

We make modern living possible, and our employee owners are proud of it. 100% employee-owned since
1986, ownership is at the heart of everything we do. From our product innovation to our
acquisitions, doing the right thing for our customers and employees is why we exist.

[ See the Sentry Difference ][46]

## Need More Help?

Contact our Specialists for Answers

# Patients are at the center of everything we do.

# You can go four weeks without food. 
# Four days without water.
# But only four minutes without breathing.

## Why We Exist

## Ensuring Policies Are Patient-Focused For Improved Outcomes

Who We Are

We are a national nonprofit advocacy organization dedicated to serving those living with
sleep-disordered breathing, or who have been diagnosed with obstructive sleep apnea.


What We Do

We strive to represent diverse patient voices at local, regional and national levels through
education, advocacy, and support to eliminate gaps in patient care.


What is our Objective?

To be the leading driving force in changing the current sleep apnea health care delivery model by
ensuring that the existing health care policies benefit patients and improve their health outcomes.

[Join the Community ][35]
[many faces of sleep apnea]

## ASAP Empowers

## Informational Videos

## ASAP Educates

## What Patients Need To Know

[[Sleeping Woman]][36]
[
][37]

Understanding Sleep Apnea

Sleep Apnea is a common but serious sleep disorder. The disorder is caused by repetitive periods
when airflow is interrupted during sleep due to a narrowing or closure to the throat.

[[Man Sleeping Wearing a CPAP Machine]][38]
[
][39]

Diagnosing Sleep Apnea

Sleep clinics want you to stay as close to your night-time routine as possible in order to get the
best results. Most sleep labs will give you check-in instructions a day or two before your study.

[[CPAP Machine]][40]
[
][41]

Treatment Options

For milder cases of sleep apnea, your doctor may recommend only lifestyle changes, such as losing
weight or reducing alcohol consumption.

[[Sleeping Couple]][42]
[
][43]

Living with Sleep Apnea

Sleep apnea increases during pregnancy, particularly during the third trimester or with extra weight
gain. Seek out all the treatment options. Track how you are feeling daily by creating a log or
system.

DISCLAIMER: This site is here to share knowledge and experiences, not to replace the guidance of
qualified medical professionals. Every person’s journey is different. If you have concerns about
your health or treatment, please seek advice from your healthcare provider.

# Patients are at the center of everything we do.

# You can go four weeks without food. 
# Four days without water.
# But only four minutes without breathing.

## Why We Exist

## Ensuring Policies Are Patient-Focused For Improved Outcomes

Who We Are

We are a national nonprofit advocacy organization dedicated to serving those living with
sleep-disordered breathing, or who have been diagnosed with obstructive sleep apnea.


What We Do

We strive to represent diverse patient voices at local, regional and national levels through
education, advocacy, and support to eliminate gaps in patient care.


What is our Objective?

To be the leading driving force in changing the current sleep apnea health care delivery model by
ensuring that the existing health care policies benefit patients and improve their health outcomes.

[Join the Community ][35]
[many faces of sleep apnea]

## ASAP Empowers

## Informational Videos

## ASAP Educates

## What Patients Need To Know

[[Sleeping Woman]][36]
[
][37]

Understanding Sleep Apnea

Sleep Apnea is a common but serious sleep disorder. The disorder is caused by repetitive periods
when airflow is interrupted during sleep due to a narrowing or closure to the throat.

[[Man Sleeping Wearing a CPAP Machine]][38]
[
][39]

Diagnosing Sleep Apnea

Sleep clinics want you to stay as close to your night-time routine as possible in order to get the
best results. Most sleep labs will give you check-in instructions a day or two before your study.

[[CPAP Machine]][40]
[
][41]

Treatment Options

For milder cases of sleep apnea, your doctor may recommend only lifestyle changes, such as losing
weight or reducing alcohol consumption.

[[Sleeping Couple]][42]
[
][43]

Living with Sleep Apnea

Sleep apnea increases during pregnancy, particularly during the third trimester or with extra weight
gain. Seek out all the treatment options. Track how you are feeling daily by creating a log or
system.

DISCLAIMER: This site is here to share knowledge and experiences, not to replace the guidance of
qualified medical professionals. Every person’s journey is different. If you have concerns about
your health or treatment, please seek advice from your healthcare provider.

## About Aristo

Aristo Pharma, headquartered in Berlin, was founded in 2008 and is now one of the fast-growing
pharmaceutical companies in Europe.

Our ambition is to rethink healthcare and continuously advance pharmaceutical solutions – with the
goal of making therapies effective, well-tolerated, and easy to use at the same time.

Our portfolio includes prescription medicines, innovative medical devices, OTC products, and herbal
preparations, covering a broad spectrum of modern healthcare solutions.

More than 1,400 employees across 13 countries contribute every day to ensuring that our products
reliably reach where they are needed most – physicians, pharmacies, wholesalers, and patients.

### Infrastructure

Arni Medica, founded in 2019 in Hyderabad, India, manufactures therapeutic medical devices and a
growing In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) portfolio. Our domains include Nephrology, Infusion Therapy,
Cardiology, Urology, Gastroenterology, Gynecology, and Clinical Diagnostics.

### Certifications

Our quality management systems have been meticulously designed to meet the stringent requirements
and standards outlined in ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016, ensuring compliance and certification.

[ Learn More ][98]

### Contract Manufacturing

We offer personalized manufacturing solutions for both therapeutic devices and IVD products. Our
optimized supply chain supports inbound/outbound logistics, vertical integration, supplier curation,
and vendor management covering reagents, consumables, and analyzers alongside medical devices.

hematology, coagulation, molecular diagnostics, rapid tests, and analyzers all backed by the same
quality and manufacturing excellence.**

optimized supply chain supports inbound/outbound logistics, vertical integration, supplier curation,

With highest technology and innovation for **medical device and IVD life cycle
management **including Design R&D, Prototyping, Component Manufacturing, Final Assembly, Packing,
Labeling, and Sterilization.

At Arni Medica, we strive to satisfy the needs of the most demanding customers and their patients
with the most effective, safe, and profitable treatments in the market. Our expertise lies in
developing innovative products in **Orthopedics, Medical & Surgical, Cardiac, Gynecology, Urology,
and In Vitro Diagnostics **helping improve patient and hospital outcomes.

By enabling better care, we improve quality of life, reduce the impact of ailments, and lower costs
for consumers and healthcare systems. **Our IVD portfolio spans clinical chemistry, immunoassay,
hematology, coagulation, molecular diagnostics, rapid tests, and analyzers all backed by the same
quality and manufacturing excellence.**

## clinical laboratories and point-of-care settings worldwide. Our capabil
* Clinical Chemistry Reagents & Analyzers – 40+ parameters, fully/semi-auto systems

## Making your medical device a success, without the guesswork

Our process connects design, engineering, regulatory expertise, and manufacturing into one
accountable pathway — helping medtech teams move faster with less risk.

[ Explore Our Prototype Sprint ][121]

## Tailored to your journey

### Startups

Turn your concept into a manufacturable prototype with clarity and speed. We give startups
structured momentum and regulatory confidence from day one.

[ See how we help Startups ][122]

### OEMs

Unblock projects and scale faster with an embedded partner you can trust. We provide OEMs with
external capacity, compliance, and global scalability.

[ See how we help OEMs ][123]

## Your first step:
## The Prototype Sprint

The Prototype Sprint is a structured, fixed-scope engagement that delivers a manufacturable
prototype and regulatory clarity in 90 to 180 days. It is the fastest and safest way to build
momentum for your project.

## Global capability, proven in Costa Rica

Our Costa Rica facility combines FDA-grade quality with cost-efficient scalability, giving OEMs
confidence to move from prototype into full production.

## The strengths behind every project

#### Speed with Structure

From concept to prototype in 90 to 180 days, with clarity at every step.

#### Integrated Model

Design, engineering, and regulatory aligned in one accountable partner.

#### Regulatory Built-In

Compliance from day one, no costly rework later.

#### Global Execution

Future-proofed for scale with Ireland, Boston, and Costa Rica capacity.

## Making your medical device a success, without the guesswork

Our process connects design, engineering, regulatory expertise, and manufacturing into one
accountable pathway — helping medtech teams move faster with less risk.

[ Explore Our Prototype Sprint ][121]

## Tailored to your journey

### Startups

Turn your concept into a manufacturable prototype with clarity and speed. We give startups
structured momentum and regulatory confidence from day one.

[ See how we help Startups ][122]

### OEMs

Unblock projects and scale faster with an embedded partner you can trust. We provide OEMs with
external capacity, compliance, and global scalability.

[ See how we help OEMs ][123]

## Your first step:
## The Prototype Sprint

The Prototype Sprint is a structured, fixed-scope engagement that delivers a manufacturable
prototype and regulatory clarity in 90 to 180 days. It is the fastest and safest way to build
momentum for your project.

## Global capability, proven in Costa Rica

Our Costa Rica facility combines FDA-grade quality with cost-efficient scalability, giving OEMs
confidence to move from prototype into full production.

## The strengths behind every project

#### Speed with Structure

From concept to prototype in 90 to 180 days, with clarity at every step.

#### Integrated Model

Design, engineering, and regulatory aligned in one accountable partner.

#### Regulatory Built-In

Compliance from day one, no costly rework later.

#### Global Execution

Future-proofed for scale with Ireland, Boston, and Costa Rica capacity.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.

  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.

  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

In the intricate world of construction, your project deserves a general contractor with the
flexibility and expertise to make your dreams a reality.

Project programming services

**We fast-track project success by comparing your plan against thousands of similar projects. **
This information allows us to build a budget and plan that fits your needs, translates easily into
design, and reduces costly rework.

Design management

**The earlier we get involved, the better the outcome—and design is where it all begins.** Using
tried and true methods like integrated project delivery and design-build, we operate at a higher
level and deliver a streamlined, stress-free process with your goals as our guide.

Engineering services

**Our engineers are problem solvers who come up with creative construction solutions and lead
design-assist and design-build efforts across a range of projects.** By working hand-in-hand with
our construction teams, they’re uniquely empowered to offer innovative solutions that others can’t.

Procurement solutions

**We adapt to challenges using strategic industry connections and creative approaches to reduce
supply chain uncertainty. ** This improves speed-to-market, maintains cost predictability, and keeps
surprises at bay.

[Five Brasfield & Gorrie construction workers in safety gear and helmets stand on a site with a
crane and cloudy sky in the background.]

SELF-PERFORM

## Builders from the beginning

We're true builders who can bring complex projects to life with our own teams for more control over
cost, quality, and schedule. If it sounds like a win-win, that’s because it is.

## Dehumidification

### **MASS dehumidification: ** Our air handlers are capable of massive amounts of dehumidification
### at a fraction of the cost of traditional stand alone units!

### Some competing dehumidifiers cost more than $3000 each (just for dehumidification!), only
### produce 215 pints/day (27 gallons/day), and can cost more than $1000/year to run!

### Just one of our 5 ton air handlers can produce up to **650 pints/day** (81 gallons/day) and can
### use effectively free energy from our "Hot Gas Recovery" chiller option for reheat!

### Our dehumidifiers:
* Are significantly less expensive
* Cost next to nothing to run
* And provide **3X the dehumidification!**

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

#### Hospital

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

[Learn more][84]

#### Safety

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

#### Contact

Get in touch with Dräger. We are happy to help.

[Contact Us][86]

Dräger X-node is a wireless IoT solution for process monitoring and analysis. The system solution

store online via the X-node Hub.

As trusted partners, we are dedicated to ensuring that no matter the complexity of the task, you

workplace hazards, industrial accidents and emergency response risks persist.

save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,

## Chiller Tornillo Ecogreen ECCLWV06ZJ

### De la serie Magnificent

Independientemente del ángulo desde el que se mire, este chiller irradia un diseño vanguardista y un
rendimiento de última generación.

En su corazón se encuentra el revolucionario compresor de tornillo 06Z con variador de frecuencia,
que incorpora un diseño de velocidad variable Carlyle® de doble tornillo diseñado específicamente
para aplicaciones de temperatura media a alta. Totalmente cualificado para su uso con
refrigerantes** R-134a, R-1234ze y R-513A,** el ECCLW06ZJ establece un nuevo punto de referencia en
eficiencia y fiabilidad.

### Export Promotion Council for Medical Devices

EPCMD-India, established in the year 2023 under the umbrella of the Department of Pharmaceuticals,
with the facilitation of the Department of Commerce, Government of India, and YEIDA, Government of
Uttar Pradesh, serves as a launching platform to introduce medical devices made in India to
international markets worldwide. The EPCMD is an exclusive Indian government organization to launch
the country's medical devices on an international platform. Serving as a connecting link between
manufacturers, the government, and international markets, EPCMD-India aims to unlock all possible
export capabilities and ensure that medical technology in India leads the global healthcare system.

EPCMD-India is specifically geared to promotion, counseling, as well as facilitation regarding the
harmonization of regulatory requirements, trade facilitation, as well as market intelligence for
Indian manufacturers of medical devices. The orientation is towards helping new as well as existing
Indian manufacturers of medical devices to tackle the challenge posed by international trade as well
as extending their boundaries.

### Export Promotion Council for Medical Devices

EPCMD-India, established in the year 2023 under the umbrella of the Department of Pharmaceuticals,
with the facilitation of the Department of Commerce, Government of India, and YEIDA, Government of
Uttar Pradesh, serves as a launching platform to introduce medical devices made in India to
international markets worldwide. The EPCMD is an exclusive Indian government organization to launch
the country's medical devices on an international platform. Serving as a connecting link between
manufacturers, the government, and international markets, EPCMD-India aims to unlock all possible
export capabilities and ensure that medical technology in India leads the global healthcare system.

EPCMD-India is specifically geared to promotion, counseling, as well as facilitation regarding the
harmonization of regulatory requirements, trade facilitation, as well as market intelligence for
Indian manufacturers of medical devices. The orientation is towards helping new as well as existing
Indian manufacturers of medical devices to tackle the challenge posed by international trade as well
as extending their boundaries.

Chillers are the unsung heroes of industrial processing. The backbone of heat-producing machinery,
reliable process chillers are a vital part of any operation’s quest to eliminate downtime.
EVRCOOL**®** process chillers take cool to a new level with a patented condenser door, removable
refrigeration unit, smaller footprint, and revolutionary plumbing design. Switch to EVRCOOL and
chill.

## Install and Chill

Let us take the heat

We’ve reimagined the industrial chiller. We’ve built an efficient, ECO friendly, low GWP refrigerant
chiller that packs more cooling capacity into a smaller footprint than any other process chiller on
the market.

[

learn more

][26]
[industrial chiller built to last]

### Built to Last

Swing-open door allows easy access for serviceability

Custom designed I/O interface PCB minimizes electrical connection points that are prone to failure

Removable refrigeration unit enables the compressors and refrigeration control devices to be changed
in the field without reclaiming refrigerant

Stainless steel process plumbing minimizes the number of connection points and potential for leaks

Onboard sensors monitor every aspect of the chiller operation and provide real-time diagnostic
feedback through the IoT platform

[EVRCOOL indoor outdoor industrial chiller ]

### Designed for Flexibility

Curved condenser coil integrated into the service access door utilizes 3 sides of the chiller for
heat transfer, minimizing factory floor space requirements

Variable speed condenser fan and electronic expansion valves enable both indoor and outdoor
operation

Tandem compressors and motorized hot gas valves enable precise temperature control over a wide range
of heat loads, ambient temperatures, and leaving fluid temperatures

Variable speed pumps enable a single chiller to meet the process flow and pressure requirements for
a wide range of customer equipment

Intuitive touch screen user interface

Variable speed pumps & compressors automatically adapt to customer operating conditions

Custom chiller controller integrates into all standard communication protocol

Swing-open door allows easy access for serviceability

Custom designed I/O interface PCB minimizes electrical connection points that are prone to failure

Removable refrigeration unit enables the compressors and refrigeration control devices to be changed
in the field without reclaiming refrigerant

Stainless steel process plumbing minimizes the number of connection points and potential for leaks

Onboard sensors monitor every aspect of the chiller operation and provide real-time diagnostic
feedback through the IoT platform

Curved condenser coil integrated into the service access door utilizes 3 sides of the chiller for
heat transfer, minimizing factory floor space requirements

Variable speed condenser fan and electronic expansion valves enable both indoor and outdoor
operation

Tandem compressors and motorized hot gas valves enable precise temperature control over a wide range
of heat loads, ambient temperatures, and leaving fluid temperatures

Variable speed pumps enable a single chiller to meet the process flow and pressure requirements for
a wide range of customer equipment

## Our Mission Is To Develop Therapies that Are:
## Tough on Cancer,
## Gentle on Patients.

The Vanquish^{®} Water Vapor Ablation System is a transurethral, outpatient procedure designed to
ablate targeted prostate tissue using the thermal energy stored in sterile water vapor.

[Learn More][20]

## Technology and Knowledge Converge

The Vanquish System utilizes the growing body of clinical data, improved prostate imaging and biopsy
technologies, and patient advocacy to offer a new option for patients.

[[Vanquish]][21]

One in 8 men will be diagnosed with prostate cancer in their lifetime. The majority of men with
localized, low-to-intermediate risk prostate cancer will be presented with one of two options: whole
prostate gland removal or radiation, which have a high potential for long-term side effects, or
active surveillance, which allows them to maintain their quality of life.

Disclosure: The Vanquish^{®} Water Vapor Ablation System has been cleared as a tool for the thermal
ablation of targeted prostate tissue via a transurethral approach. The FDA has not evaluated the
Vanquish System for the treatment of any disease, including prostate cancer, or evaluated the
Vanquish System for any long-term prostate cancer treatment outcomes.

[Learn More][22]

The Vanquish System provides targeted ablation of prostate tissue in any location in the prostate.

**How the Technology Works**

The Vanquish^{®} System is a breakthrough technology that uses the energy stored in sterile water
vapor to ablate targeted prostate tissue. Water vapor respects the natural boundaries of the
targeted tissue, minimizing or eliminating damage to surrounding structure.

[Learn More][23]

## Clinical Evidence.

**VAPOR 2 Multi-Center Pivotal Study (n=235) **
The VAPOR 2 Study is a novel, multi-center trial using a transurethral thermal water vapor device
(Vanquish System) to manage localized intermediate-risk prostate cancer. Enrollment is complete and
patients will be followed for five years.

[ADDITIONAL INFORMATION][24]

## VAPOR 2 (n=110)
## Clinical Data and Patient Satisfaction Results:

#### 91%

clearance of targeted MRI visible ≥GG2 disease following a single treatment

#### 2.7%

≥ Grade 2 urinary incontinence

#### No device related

serious adverse events

#### Low rates of

erectile dysfunction

#### 93%

of patients were extremely satisfied or satisfied with the Vanquish procedure at 12 months (n=107)

#### 94%

of the patients believed that the Vanquish procedure was a good decision (n=107)

#### Minimal to no pain

Most patient reported no pain.

## Your leading supplier of single-use medical device components

Qosina is a leading medical device component supplier of disposable OEM components to the medical
and pharmaceutical industries. Companies purchase from Qosina to eliminate tooling costs and receive
immediate delivery of single-use medical components from inventory. Ordering from Qosina will save
you time and money because we provide in-stock solutions from our ISO 13485, ISO 9001, ISO 22301 and
ISO 14001 certified facility. Sourcing requests are welcome for tool modifications, hard-to-find
items, sub-assemblies or tubing to meet your specifications. The Qosina full-line catalog contains
OEM medical device component supplies and features full-scale photographs of thousands of stock
components on a one-centimeter grid.

## Disposable Medical Components in Bulk from Qosina

The Qosina product line consists of disposable medical device components including angiographic
needles, applicators, bioprocessing components, catheter hubs, check valves, clips, clamps,
connectors, extension lines, forceps, gauze, hemostasis valves, instrument guards, kit components,
luers, masks, needleless injection sites, ports, pouches, quick disconnect couplings, sanitary
flanges, safety scalpels, single-use stainless steel, spikes, sponges, stopcocks, swabs, torquers,
trays, tuohy borst adapters, USP class VI tubing. The vast product range of medical device
components, along with complimentary samples, makes Qosina the first stop for all design engineers
and purchasing agents who are sourcing disposable medical components for current and future
projects. Custom sourcing services are available through our knowledgeable specialists using Qosina’
s extensive resources. Qosina operates in an ISO 13485, ISO 9001, ISO 22301 and ISO 14001 certified
facility. Qosina offers low minimums and short lead times on plastic medical device components.

# INNOVATIONS IN CARING

### TERUMO INTERVENTIONAL SYSTEMS (TIS)

TIS is a market leader in providing solutions that enable minimally invasive entry site management,
lesion access and therapeutic intervention for cardiology, peripheral arterial disease,
embolotherapy and interventional oncology.

### TERUMO HEALTH OUTCOMES (THO)

THO partners with clinicians and hospitals to help them improve patient outcomes, optimize
operations and provide process investment guidance that can lead to cost savings. 

### TERUMO MEDICAL PRODUCTS (TMP)

TMP designs injection and infusion therapy devices that allow clinicians to deliver the very best
day-to-day care to their patients in both the human and animal health markets.

### PHARMACEUTICAL SOLUTIONS DIVISION (PSD)

PSD offers pharmaceutical and medical device companies worldwide comprehensive product design and
development services.

# INNOVATIONS IN CARING

### TERUMO INTERVENTIONAL SYSTEMS (TIS)

TIS is a market leader in providing solutions that enable minimally invasive entry site management,
lesion access and therapeutic intervention for cardiology, peripheral arterial disease,
embolotherapy and interventional oncology.

### TERUMO HEALTH OUTCOMES (THO)

THO partners with clinicians and hospitals to help them improve patient outcomes, optimize
operations and provide process investment guidance that can lead to cost savings. 

### TERUMO MEDICAL PRODUCTS (TMP)

TMP designs injection and infusion therapy devices that allow clinicians to deliver the very best
day-to-day care to their patients in both the human and animal health markets.

### PHARMACEUTICAL SOLUTIONS DIVISION (PSD)

PSD offers pharmaceutical and medical device companies worldwide comprehensive product design and
development services.

The Global Laser Chiller Sales Leader

TEYU S&A has dominated global laser chiller sales from 2015 to 2025. Founded in 2002 in Guangzhou,
we specialize in advanced laser cooling solutions. With our TEYU and S&A brands, we prioritize
quality, reliability, and durability. Committed to energy-efficient cooling, we aim to lead the
industrial refrigeration industry with cutting-edge solutions.

Featured Products

TEYU S&A Chiller delivers what it promises - providing high performance, highly reliable and energy
efficient industrial water chillers with superior quality.

Low-GWP refrigerant options are available for selected models.

CO2 Laser Chiller 

TEYU CW-series water chillers are specifically designed to regulate the temperature of CO2 laser
systems used for engraving, cutting, and marking non-metal materials. Overheating can reduce
performance and cause costly downtime, making a stable cooling solution essential.



These CO2 laser chillers offer cooling capacities from 600W to 45,000W with temperature stability
from ±0.3°C to ±1°C. With compact designs, easy maintenance, and high reliability, they are ideal
for supporting CO2 laser applications in various industrial environments.

Fiber Laser Chiller 

Fiber lasers generate significant heat during high-precision metal processing, which can lead to
decreased efficiency and system damage if not properly cooled. TEYU CWFL series water chillers
provide stable and efficient cooling for fiber laser systems.

 

These fiber laser chillers support fiber laser powers from 1kW to 240kW and feature dual temperature
control circuits. With precise control accuracy and intelligent features like RS-485 communication,
they ensure long-term performance and system protection.

Industrial Process Chiller

TEYU industrial process chillers offer dependable cooling for a wide range of industrial machinery,
including CNC machines, UV printers, vacuum systems, and more. These closed-loop chillers are known
for their durability and energy efficiency.

 

With cooling capacities from 600W to 45,000W and temperature stability from ±0.3°C to ±1°C, TEYU
industrial process chillers provide accurate thermal management. Their air-cooled design ensures
convenient installation and low maintenance across various industrial setups.

Precision Chiller

For high-accuracy laser and lab applications, TEYU S&A offers precision chillers with ultra-stable
temperature control. These include the CWUP series (stand-alone chillers) and RMUP series (rack
mount chillers), both designed to meet exacting standards.

 

The CWUP series maintains a stability of ±0.08°C to ±0.1°C, while RMUP models offer ±0.1°C
stability. Equipped with PID control, these precision chillers are ideal for UV lasers, ultrafast
lasers, and scientific instruments requiring precise thermal regulation.

SGS & UL Chiller

TEYU S&A provides SGS-certified chillers and UL-certified chillers that comply with strict North
American safety standards, making them ideal for OEMs and users in regulated markets. These chiller
models offer high reliability for both general and high-power laser cooling.

 

Certified like CW-5200TI (1.77/2.08kW, ±0.3°C) and CW-6200BN (4.8kW, ±0.5°C) meet the needs of
low-power systems. High-power models including CWFL-3000HNP to CWFL-30000KT support fiber lasers
from 3kW to 30kW, each with dual circuit cooling and intelligent control.

The Global Laser Chiller Sales Leader

TEYU S&A has dominated global laser chiller sales from 2015 to 2025. Founded in 2002 in Guangzhou,
we specialize in advanced laser cooling solutions. With our TEYU and S&A brands, we prioritize
quality, reliability, and durability. Committed to energy-efficient cooling, we aim to lead the
industrial refrigeration industry with cutting-edge solutions.

Featured Products

TEYU S&A Chiller delivers what it promises - providing high performance, highly reliable and energy
efficient industrial water chillers with superior quality.

Low-GWP refrigerant options are available for selected models.

CO2 Laser Chiller 

TEYU CW-series water chillers are specifically designed to regulate the temperature of CO2 laser
systems used for engraving, cutting, and marking non-metal materials. Overheating can reduce
performance and cause costly downtime, making a stable cooling solution essential.



These CO2 laser chillers offer cooling capacities from 600W to 45,000W with temperature stability
from ±0.3°C to ±1°C. With compact designs, easy maintenance, and high reliability, they are ideal
for supporting CO2 laser applications in various industrial environments.

Fiber Laser Chiller 

Fiber lasers generate significant heat during high-precision metal processing, which can lead to
decreased efficiency and system damage if not properly cooled. TEYU CWFL series water chillers
provide stable and efficient cooling for fiber laser systems.

 

These fiber laser chillers support fiber laser powers from 1kW to 240kW and feature dual temperature
control circuits. With precise control accuracy and intelligent features like RS-485 communication,
they ensure long-term performance and system protection.

Industrial Process Chiller

TEYU industrial process chillers offer dependable cooling for a wide range of industrial machinery,
including CNC machines, UV printers, vacuum systems, and more. These closed-loop chillers are known
for their durability and energy efficiency.

 

With cooling capacities from 600W to 45,000W and temperature stability from ±0.3°C to ±1°C, TEYU
industrial process chillers provide accurate thermal management. Their air-cooled design ensures
convenient installation and low maintenance across various industrial setups.

Precision Chiller

For high-accuracy laser and lab applications, TEYU S&A offers precision chillers with ultra-stable
temperature control. These include the CWUP series (stand-alone chillers) and RMUP series (rack
mount chillers), both designed to meet exacting standards.

 

The CWUP series maintains a stability of ±0.08°C to ±0.1°C, while RMUP models offer ±0.1°C
stability. Equipped with PID control, these precision chillers are ideal for UV lasers, ultrafast
lasers, and scientific instruments requiring precise thermal regulation.

SGS & UL Chiller

TEYU S&A provides SGS-certified chillers and UL-certified chillers that comply with strict North
American safety standards, making them ideal for OEMs and users in regulated markets. These chiller
models offer high reliability for both general and high-power laser cooling.

 

Certified like CW-5200TI (1.77/2.08kW, ±0.3°C) and CW-6200BN (4.8kW, ±0.5°C) meet the needs of
low-power systems. High-power models including CWFL-3000HNP to CWFL-30000KT support fiber lasers
from 3kW to 30kW, each with dual circuit cooling and intelligent control.

## Begin Your Journey To Recovery And Wellness With ThermoTek

ThermoTek is a leading manufacturer of innovative thermoelectric solutions for the medical and
scientific fields. Founded in 1993, we consistently demonstrated our commitment to advancing the
field of thermal management for the medical, scientific, and military sectors through our patented
and trade-secret technology, ISO-certified quality standards, and customer-centric approach. With
more than 30 years of experience, ThermoTek provides the thermal-management services you require.

## Begin Your Journey To Recovery And Wellness With ThermoTek

ThermoTek is a leading manufacturer of innovative thermoelectric solutions for the medical and
scientific fields. Founded in 1993, we consistently demonstrated our commitment to advancing the
field of thermal management for the medical, scientific, and military sectors through our patented
and trade-secret technology, ISO-certified quality standards, and customer-centric approach. With
more than 30 years of experience, ThermoTek provides the thermal-management services you require.

## Every single person at Thetford makes the difference

While we come from different backgrounds and cultures, we all have and share the same values in the
way we work with each other.

We do not just make products, we create them. Every step we make together with our colleagues. We
imagine, create, develop, produce, transport and support.

We work together with thinkers and with doers, so we can act global, think local and do what we
love.

[toss ins 16ct aqua kem resized]

### Blue is back!

One of our most popular RV holding tank treatments, Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins®, has returned. Perfect for
RVs and marine applications, the Bronopol-based formula liquefies waste, breaks down tissue, and
delivers superior odor control.

[ Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins® ][67]
[Thetford Aqua Magic VI Homepage Banner]

### Constantly improving RV sanitation

Introducing the Aqua-Magic® VI, a lightweight RV toilet designed to bring the comfort of a home
toilet to your travels, along with easy cleaning and low maintenance.

[ Aqua-Magic® VI ][68]
[Titan Tote 4 wheel Airstream Homepage Banner]

### Changing the standards

At Thetford®, we never stop looking for ways to improve and break patterns. Titan® portable totes
have the industry’s lowest fill height. This makes allows easy emptying for even the lowest RV waste
valves.

[ Portable totes ][69]

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

## Viant Company FAQs

### What does Viant do as a medical device contract manufacturing company?

Viant is a medical device contract manufacturer providing end-to-end contract manufacturing for
medical devices—from design and development through precision manufacturing, sterile and non-sterile
device assembly. OEMs and MedTech startups partner with Viant as a single-source manufacturer of
medical devices or engage specific capabilities as needed.

### What makes Viant different from other medical device contract manufacturers?

A vertically integrated model with global manufacturing facilities is what differentiates Viant from
many medical device contract manufacturers. With ViaLaunch™ program management, engineering support,
and quality management systems across its footprint, device manufacturers can move from development
into production with stronger risk mitigation, process validation, and scalable production volume.

### What capabilities does Viant offer for contract manufacturing for medical devices?

A broad set of contract manufacturing services across the device lifecycle: program management,
medical device engineering support, materials expertise, metals (including metal tubing),
extrusions, medical‑grade plastics (including micro‑molding), tooling, automation capabilities,
device assembly, and finished device services. Viant combines these capabilities within a vertically
integrated manufacturing network.

### What clinical markets does Viant support?

Viant supports a range of clinical device applications, including Orthopedics, Surgical
Technologies, Cardiac & Interventional, Drug Delivery, Bioprocessing, Bioelectronics, Diagnostics &
Laboratory Products, and Respiratory, Monitoring & Patient Care.

### How large is Viant’s manufacturing footprint?

A global manufacturing footprint of 26 locations, 2.3M square feet of manufacturing space, and 300K+
square feet of cleanroom space. With Viant, device manufacturers can leverage regional production
options and scalable capacity across programs.
